purpose: Close cancellation, ambiguous attribution and unsupported cross-slave order gaps before a separately frozen matched B/C rerun.
DUT_driver_targets_denominator_policy: Keep existing original sources, public pins, JSON driver, all17 target counters and2845 denominator unless a separately justified future registration explicitly changes them. No new target/budget selection using C results.

roles.Claude: Independently author specification obligations, property-aware checker and selftests; fresh review.
roles.GPT: Register integration gates, synthetic controls, fixed driver/stimulus and proof-only transport/observation. Do not author or modify functional golden checker logic.

offline_probe.classification: Fixed-version characterization only; cannot replace a missing normative cancellation contract or discharge old-request identity.

required_gates: Claude-reviewed clause matrix distinguishes normative requirement, environment assumption, inference and unsupported claim; unsupported cross-slave forward order cannot alone justify DUT violation.

Ambiguity handling keeps all feasible ownership histories or a sound symbolic abstraction. Do not guess owners or stop all unrelated checking until reset. Any resource limit remains explicit unresolved, never arbitrary pruning or pass.
Pending, canceled, externally observed and proven-complete obligations are separate. Quiescent outputs alone do not erase old pending identities. No arbitrary cancellation grace period.

Independent positive and single-fault controls cover cross-slave forwarding with ordered retirement, reversed retirement, identical owners, later disambiguation, corruption during ambiguity, multiple aborts, restart and reset. All classifications independently reviewed before replay.

Properties used to discharge cancellation obligations require independent authority or separately marked fixed-version certificates, with all assumptions, nonvacuity and negative controls. BMC no counterexample is not an unbounded proof.

New checker/contract and actual driver are independently reviewed and frozen before saved-action replay. Preserve all old results and all unsupported obligations. Any observed infrastructure/checker issue blocks new live generation.

After replay audit passes, freeze a new B/C scope with common instructions, coverage selection and original budget. Report property-level checked/unknown coverage and all not-reached results. Same prior WBXBAR targets remain a known-easy exploratory control, not a discriminating efficacy benchmark.
